notes:
The partial-smile versus nonsmile contrast is described as nonsignificant, but no numerical effect size, contrast test statistic or exact/bounded p is printed. Omnibus χ² values belong to different tests and were not substituted. Original title and DOI verified from full primary paper. Replication title/DOI matched the institutional PDF search record, but full text could not be acquired: Tilburg PDF routes returned HTTP 403; repository web retrieval timed out; author institutional route yielded no accessible paper link. No replication statistics or narrative verdict inferred from abstract or secondary sources.
Source follow-up: Published copy, internal page numbers 1–7. Numerics checked on rendered PDF p. 4. No individual contrast test statistic printed; retained printed b and same-test p without conversion (HR = 1.11). Locator lacks sample/model specificity, hence target_match null. Nonoverlapping sample Model II alternative: b = 0.098, p = .382, HR = 1.10; N = 527. Original-only summaries in this replication paper are not extracted. Success quote explicitly elides interleaved left-column text.
